scope.coins: every coin present in quickwin_markouts.npz; the check is a sign convention and is not cut by coin

declared_not_confirmed.note: settings.py declares these; this run did not state what it used, so they are the declaration and not a property of this artifact

checks.name: opens_book_zero_realized_pnl
checks.assumption: closed_pnl ~ 0 on opens (is_open==1); realized PnL is booked only on closes/reduces (is_open==0)
checks.method: fraction of opens with |closed_pnl| < eps (eps=1e-6*median(notional)) and mean|closed_pnl| on opens vs closes
checks.note: 0.999999 of opens sit within eps=0.000553 of zero; mean|closed_pnl| on closes (160.279) >> on opens (3.15e-07). closed_pnl is booked on closes, ~0 on opens. NOTE: this check is PROVABLY SIGN-BLIND - it is on |closed_pnl|, identical under a closed_pnl sign flip, so it contributes ZERO sign information; the sign is pinned by the A2 wallet-Spearman flip-test plus the external Hyperliquid doc.

checks.name: sign_closed_pnl_vs_markout
checks.assumption: positive closed_pnl = taker realized a profit; the sign-sensitive per-wallet Spearman(sum closed_pnl over closes, mean mo60) is POSITIVE (reproduces the m4 ~+0.030) and FLIPS to its negative when closed_pnl is negated, proving the sign is genuinely selected
checks.method: DECISIVE: sign-sensitive per-wallet Spearman(sum closed_pnl over closes, mean mo60) with a closed_pnl-negation FLIP-TEST (pooled + per-coin), asserting sign(as_read)>0. The trade-grain per-decile mean / frac(closed_pnl>0) test is reported but is uninformative by construction (close PnL realizes on inventory opened earlier, not this trade's markout)
checks.note: sign confirmed at the WALLET grain by a sign-sensitive statistic: per-wallet Spearman(sum closed_pnl over closes, mean mo10) = +0.0352 (m4 pooled +0.0352, gap 0.00000, agrees; per-coin BTC +0.0473, ETH +0.0247, both positive). FLIP-TEST: negating closed_pnl drives this Spearman to -0.0352 = exactly its negative, proving the sign is genuinely selected (not sign-blind). The strict trade-grain per-decile mean test (top -1.963, bottom -50.859) is UNINFORMATIVE BY CONSTRUCTION - a close-leg's closed_pnl realizes on inventory opened earlier, not on this trade's forward markout - so it is reported but not used as sign evidence. This pairs with the external Hyperliquid doc (closedPnl is profit-positive: +8722.99 on a winning Close Long, -2.5515 on a losing Close Short).

checks.name: partial_zero_sum_magnitude
checks.assumption: summing closed_pnl over the taker legs we hold is NOT exactly zero (we keep taker + dominant maker, not all legs) but the net should be a small, two-sided fraction of gross
checks.method: net sum / gross sum of |closed_pnl| over all finite taker legs
checks.note: net sum closed_pnl over taker legs = 10,473,498.94 on gross 194,427,443.29 (|net|/gross = 0.0539 <= 0.25). Small, two-sided as expected for a partial-leg subset; no runaway one-sided total. NOTE: |net|/gross is PROVABLY SIGN-BLIND - flipping the sign of closed_pnl leaves |net|/gross unchanged - so this check contributes ZERO sign information; the sign is pinned by the A2 wallet-Spearman flip-test plus the external Hyperliquid doc.
